enable_disable_caching: disable dataset caching to force transforms to always recompute cache files in a temporary directory
generate_fingerprint: generate a deterministic fingerprint hash for a dataset based on its current state and cache file timestamps
update_fingerprint: update a dataset fingerprint by hashing a transform function and its arguments to produce a new fingerprint
fingerprint_transform_decorator: decorate a dataset transform function to automatically update the dataset fingerprint after each transform call
format_kwargs_for_fingerprint: format transform function kwargs into a fingerprint-ready dictionary by filtering defaults and handling randomized seeds
